full_extraction.note: the tray alone; Kardex publishes no size for the extraction device or the cart

sources.kardex_extraction: Kardex Remstar Shuttle XP brochure, p.6: 'With the full tray extraction device, a tray is placed in front of the access opening for loading and unloading purposes. This can be loaded onto the optional transport cart'; options list: automatic and manual tray extraction, transit trolley, factory-fitted crane, up to six access openings per unit
sources.kardex_rear: Same brochure, p.6: 'up to six access openings placed on the front or rear side of the unit'; Kardex Shuttle brochure (2021), p.5: 'an access opening on the front and rear of the device'
